itemRev.about: encryptItem writes rev + 1 of the item given (1 for a new item); updateItem one more than the higher of the stored and the given item's rev; a move or key replacement re-encrypts the decrypted item (+1). `limits`: items sealed here (not by the core) whose stored rev is any number at all: the core reads at most 2^53 − 2 (`reads`) and writes one more than that at most (`writes`: the rev after updateItem, after encryptItem of the decrypted item, and after a move), so no stored rev makes an item impossible to open or save. Open the key with accountFromSessionBytes(accountId, sessionBytes) and openVaultKey(vaultId, wrappedKey, "account", keyEpoch, false).

vaultManifest.about: term = HMAC-SHA256(HKDF(vault key, info passauth/vault-manifest-mac/v1), id ‖ 0x00 ‖ state (0 live, 1 trashed) ‖ 0x00 ‖ SHA-256(data text)); acc = sum of the terms mod 2^256 (big-endian); link = SHA-256("passauth/vault-manifest-link/v1" ‖ 0x00 ‖ version (8 bytes, big-endian) ‖ prev (32 bytes; zero for a first manifest) ‖ SHA-256(sealed text)); sealed with HKDF(vault key, info passauth/vault-manifest-key/v1), associated data passauth/vault-manifest/v1/<vault id>/<key epoch>/<version>/<prev in hex>. An item is in the trash exactly when its deleted_at is not null; deleted_at must be null/absent or a whole number above 0 (`malformed`: every entry point throws). Keys: accountFromSessionBytes(accountId, sessionBytes), then openVaultKey(vaultId, wrappedKey, "account", keyEpoch, false) for `main` and openVaultKey(vaultId, rotated.wrappedKey, "account", rotated.keyEpoch, false) for `rotated`. `manifests`: vault rows (manifest_seq, manifest_prev, manifest) with their link (manifestLink must give it). `checks`: manifestVerify(vaultId, keyEpoch of the check, the row of `manifest`, remembered version and link or none, log or none, items[`items`]) with that check's key gives `expected` exactly. `writes`: manifestNext on `manifests.current` gives seq and prev of `expected`, opens to its counts and sum, and checks out against `after` for a device that remembers `current`. `starts`: manifestStart(vaultId, keyEpoch, version, prev, items[`items`]) with that key gives seq and prev of `expected` and checks out for `remembered`.
